name: twosci
description: Seed-paper-driven literature discovery, abstract screening, citation expansion, and evidence export across Web of Science, Scopus, OpenAlex, Crossref, and IEEE Xplore.

interface.shortDescription: Run a human-like literature research workflow with WoS, Scopus, and IEEE.
interface.longDescription: TwoSCI starts from a seed paper and the user research intent, discovers deduplicated literature across Web of Science, Scopus, OpenAlex, Crossref, and IEEE Xplore, delegates abstract screening to subagents, expands one-hop citation networks, keeps screening decisions, and exports evidence-ready records.
defaultPrompt: Use my seed paper to map the field, indicators, and follow-up studies.
Search WoS, Scopus, and IEEE, then screen the abstracts with subagents.
Expand the references and citing papers of these key papers.
